lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਇਆ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur naanak jaa kau bhaiaa daiaalaa ||
lines.translation: That humble being, O Nanak, unto whom the Guru grants His Mercy,
Is forever enraptured. ||4||6||100||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
The True Guru has truly given a child.
The long-lived one has been born to this destiny.
He came to acquire a home in the womb,
and his mother's heart is so very glad. ||1||
A son is born - a devotee of the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰ ਕਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pragatiaa sabh mahi likhiaa dhur kaa || rahaau ||
lines.translation: This pre-ordained destiny has been revealed to all. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਸੀ ਮਾਸੀ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਲੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dasee maasee hukam baalak janam leeaa ||
lines.translation: In the tenth month, by the Lord's Order, the baby has been born.
Sorrow is dispelled, and great joy has ensued.
The companions blissfully sing the songs of the Guru's Bani.
This is pleasing to the Lord Master. ||2||
The vine has grown, and shall last for many generations.
The Power of the Dharma has been firmly established by the Lord.
That which my mind wishes for, the True Guru has granted.
I have become carefree, and I fix my attention on the One Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu baalak pitaa oopar kare bahu maan ||
lines.translation: As the child places so much faith in his father,
I speak as it pleases the Guru to have me speak.
This is not a hidden secret;
Guru Nanak, greatly pleased, has bestowed this gift. ||4||7||101||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:
Giving His Hand, the Perfect Guru has protected the child.
The glory of His servant has become manifest. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਪੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur gur japee guroo gur dhiaaee ||
lines.translation: I contemplate the Guru, the Guru; I meditate on the Guru, the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee kee aradaas guroo pahi paaee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: I offer my heart-felt prayer to the Guru, and it is answered. ||Pause||
I have taken to the Sanctuary of the True Divine Guru.
The service of His servant has been fulfilled. ||2||
He has preserved my soul, body, youth and breath of life.
Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru. ||3||8||102||
Aasaa, Eighth House, Kaafee, Fifth Mehl:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਬੰਦਾ ਬੈ ਖਰੀਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai ba(n)daa bai khareed sach saahib meraa ||
lines.translation: I am Your purchased slave, O True Lord Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu pi(n)d sabh tis daa sabh kichh hai teraa ||1||
lines.translation: My soul and body, and all of this, everything is Yours. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਤੂੰ ਧਣੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maan nimaane too(n) dhanee teraa bharavaasaa ||
lines.translation: You are the honor of the dishonored. O Master, in You I place my trust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਨ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਕਾਚਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin saache an tek hai so jaanahu kaachaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without the True One, any other support is false - know this well. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa hukam apaar hai koee a(n)t na paae ||
lines.translation: Your Command is infinite; no one can find its limit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਸੀ ਸੋ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis gur pooraa bhetasee so chalai rajaae ||2||
lines.translation: One who meets with the Perfect Guru, walks in the Way of the Lord's Will. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaturaaee siaanapaa kitai kaam na aaeeai ||
lines.translation: Cunning and cleverness are of no use.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਠਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tuthaa saahib jo devai soee sukh paaeeai ||3||
lines.translation: That which the Lord Master gives, by the Pleasure of His Will - that is pleasing to me. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈਅਹਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਵੈ ਨ ਬੰਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: je lakh karam kamaaeeahi kichh pavai na ba(n)dhaa ||
lines.translation: One may perform tens of thousands of actions, but attachment to things is not satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਰ ਹੋਰੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਧੰਧਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦੩॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak keetaa naam dhar hor chhodiaa dha(n)dhaa ||4||1||103||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has made the Naam his Support. He has renounced other entanglements. ||4||1||103||
Aasaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਮੈ ਭਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa mai bhaaliaa har jevad na koee ||
lines.translation: I have pursued all pleasures, but none is as great as the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur tuthe te paaeeai sach saahib soee ||1||
lines.translation: By the Pleasure of the Guru's Will, the True Lord Master is obtained. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane sad sad kurabaanaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I am forever and ever a sacrifice to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਚਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਦਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam na visarau ik khin chasaa ihu keejai daanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Please, grant me this one blessing, that I may never, even for an instant, forget Your Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਗਠੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaagath sachaa soi hai jis har dhan a(n)tar ||
lines.translation: How very fortunate are those who have the wealth of the Lord deep within the heart.
